trello.name: Queue Depth Alert Implementation
trello.desc: Implement an alerting system for queue depth in the worker fleet. Set a warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and a paging alert at 5,000 jobs. Ensure this is applied across all workers, not just payment workers. Kofi will handle the implementation in one pass.

trello.name: Retry Logic Fix in Payment Worker
trello.desc: Revise the retry logic in the payment worker, specifically in payment_worker.py within the _process_with_retry function. Change the retry strategy to use exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and ensure failed jobs are sent to a dead-letter queue at the back of the main queue. Marta will own the task and add tests simulating card processor 503s.

trello.name: Database Connection Pool Adjustment
trello.desc: Address the DB connection pool issue that worsened during the incident. Increase the default connection pool size from 20 to 100, and decouple the workers from sharing the API's connection pool. Kofi will handle the changes in the same configuration file.

trello.name: Payment Incident Runbook Update
trello.desc: Update the payment incident runbook to replace references to the old Kibana, add the queue drain procedure that was improvised during the incident, and verify that the escalation phone numbers are current. Priya is assigned this task.

trello.name: Automate Status Page Updates
trello.desc: Automate the status page update to reflect incidents faster. Wire the process so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically switches to investigating with a template message. Marta will first wire it to the checkout alert.

trello.name: Payment Processor Failover Testing Plan
trello.desc: Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of the payment processor failover. Test first in staging, then in production during a low-traffic window with a rollback plan. Kofi will lead the planning and draft, to be reviewed in two weeks.

trello.name: Redis Version Upgrade
trello.desc: Schedule an upgrade for Redis from version 6.0 (EOL) to 7.2. Ensure a proper change window is scheduled, as it involves a minor migration with config rename and changes to persistence defaults. Kofi will own the task and coordinate with the infra calendar.
